Title:
Cloud Security Engineer

Company:
Fanap was established in 1984 with the investment of the Pasargad Financial Group and a group of specialists and entrepreneurs in the field of information and communication technology. Its initial mission was to provide software and hardware services and manage technological projects for the members of the Pasargad Financial Group. Fanap began its activities by focusing on banking software. But today its scope of services has expanded to include banks, financial and credit institutions, and large companies in the country. This company is now active in various fields such as finance, banking and insurance, communications and telecommunications, smart transportation, smart health, organizational resource management, cloud infrastructure and data centers, security, and process intelligentization. By providing innovative and reliable solutions, Fanap has become one of the main and influential players in the information and communication technology industry in the country.

IT / DevOps / Server

Job description:
Job Summary We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure cloud environments. The role combines cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity expertise to ensure secure, reliable, and compliant solutions while working closely with business and technical teams. Key Responsibilities -Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure following security best practices. -Review solution designs and recommend appropriate security controls. -Develop and maintain cloud security standards, hardening guidelines, and documentation. -Implement secure networking, identity and access management, encryption, and connectivity controls. -Support solution architects and business teams by providing security guidance throughout the solution lifecycle. -Integrate security into infrastructure deployment, monitoring, automation, and operational processes. -Enhance security monitoring, incident response, and threat detection capabilities. -Perform vulnerability assessments, risk analysis, and coordinate remediation activities. -Support security incidents, compliance activities, and customer security assessments. -Research emerging threats and recommend continuous security improvements. Required Qualifications -Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. -5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, and cloud security. -Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, and infrastructure security. -Experience with vulnerability management, security hardening, and security monitoring. -Knowledge of Linux administration, networking, encryption, and security best practices. -Experience with automation or Infrastructure as Code is a plus. -Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. Preferred Skills -Cloud security architecture -Security operations and incident response -Risk assessment and threat modeling -DevSecOps practices -Compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, PCI DSS) -Scripting and automation
